mapper.select: SELECT * FROM appointment WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.*, d.status AS doctor_status, dep.status AS department_status, d.role_type AS doctor_role_type, dep.type AS department_type FROM schedule s JOIN doctor d ON d.id=s.doctor_id JOIN department dep ON dep.id=d.department_id WHERE s.id=#{scheduleId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule SET booked_count=booked_count+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{scheduleId} AND status=1 AND booked_count < total_quota
UPDATE appointment SET status='pending',pay_method=#{method},pay_time=NOW(),update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='unpaid'
UPDATE appointment SET status='checked_in',update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND pay_time IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('pending','confirmed')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM prescription WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}

SELECT p.* FROM prescription p JOIN appointment a ON a.id=p.appointment_id JOIN schedule s ON s.id=a.schedule_id WHERE p.id=#{id} AND p.user_id=#{userId} AND a.user_id=#{userId} AND p.appointment_id=#{appointmentId} AND s.doctor_id=p.doctor_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE prescription SET status='paid',pay_method=#{method},pay_time=NOW(),update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='unpaid'
UPDATE appointment SET status='pending_pickup',update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{appointmentId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='pending_rx_pay'
mapper.select: SELECT balance FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{userId} AND role='USER' AND status=1 AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET balance=balance+#{delta},update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{userId} AND role='USER' AND status=1 AND deleted=0 AND balance+#{delta} BETWEEN 0 AND 99999999.99
mapper.select: SELECT id,type,amount,balance_after,order_id,pay_method,remark,create_time FROM balance_log WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC,id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment_review WHERE appointment_id=#{appointmentId}
SELECT id,type,amount,balance_after,order_id,pay_method,remark,create_time FROM balance_log WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND type='recharge' AND remark=#{remark} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
